description_en: Calls the RunCloudBenchTask operation to execute a stress testing task
description_zh: 调用RunCloudBenchTask接口，执行压测任务
name: RunCloudBenchTask

parameters.help_en: The ID of the stress testing task. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/230670.html operation to obtain the task ID
parameters.name: task_id

PreCheckItem.description_en: The list of detailed information, including the total number of information items, error codes, and more
PreCheckItem.description_zh: 详细信息列表，包括信息的总数、错误码等

Details.description_en: The details of the check item

Message.description_en:
The returned message.

If the request is successful, Successful is returned. If the request fails, an error message such as an error code is returned
Message.description_zh:
请求返回消息。
请求成功时该参数返回Successful，请求失败时会返回请求异常信息（如错误码等）

Name.description_en:
The check item. Valid values:

SqlArchiveStatusChecker: Checks whether the SQL insight data is available.

BenchClientEnvChecker: Checks whether the execution environment on the stress testing client is available.

SpecChecker: Checks whether the instance type of the destination instance and the instance type of the stress testing client are available.

SourceInstanceChecker: Checks whether the account and network of the source instance are available.

BenchTargetChecker: Checks whether the account and network of the destination instance are available
Name.description_zh:
检查项。取值：

SqlArchiveStatusChecker：检查SQL洞察数据是否可用。
BenchClientEnvChecker：检查压测机上程序运行环境是否可用。
SpecChecker：检查压测目标规格和压测机规格是否可用。
SourceInstanceChecker：检查压测源实例账号和网络是否可用。
BenchTargetChecker：检查压测目标实例账号和网络是否可用

Order.description_en: The order of the check item. Valid values: 0 to 10
Order.description_zh: 检查项的顺序，取值范围：0~10

Status.description_en:
The status of the task. Valid values:

SUCCESS: The task is successful.

IGNORED: The task is ignored.

RUNNING: The task is running.

EXCEPTION: The task is abnormal
Status.description_zh:
任务的运行状态。取值：

SUCCESS：成功。
IGNORED：忽略。
RUNNING：运行中。
EXCEPTION：异常

Message.description_en:
The returned message.

If the request is successful, Successful is returned. If the request fails, an error message such as an error code is returned
Message.description_zh:
请求返回消息。
请求成功时该参数返回Successful，请求失败时会返回请求异常信息（如错误码等）

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.

false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否执行成功：

true：执行成功。
false：执行失败
